name: Vasectomy
overview: Scripture emphasizes the divine command to be fruitful and multiply, as seen in God's blessing to Adam and Noah (Genesis 1:28; 9:1). The responsibility to raise up offspring within the covenant community is underscored in Judah's instruction to Onan to fulfill his duty to his brother's lineage (Genesis 38:8). Additionally, the holiness required of those serving God includes physical wholeness, as blemished individuals or those with mutilations, such as having their reproductive organs cut off, are restricted from offering sacrifices or entering the congregation (Leviticus 21:17; 22:24; Deuteronomy 23:1). These passages collectively affirm the biblical value placed on procreation and the integrity of the body in relation to worship and covenant membership.
